The historical controls end two days ago and must not change: their answers stay cached.. Runs are 3 s apart ("pause"), longer than the recent-tail max staleness, so each run after the first meets an aged cache entry and times the refetch.

E1-E5, E8 and E9 hold only numbers, so they measure the counter's cost on the common path (clean queries must stay within noise of main at every range); E6 and E7 hold values Loki rejects (a unit string, hexadecimal ids), so main answers 200 and the branch answers Loki's 400. unwrap-sum-without.description: `sum without` over a range function with unwrap (PR for semantics/unwrap-sum-without-collapses): Loki keeps a series per remaining label set; the last stats pipe had no grouping and VictoriaLogs answered one row, so the proxy answered one series. A sum without over an unwrap with no parser is left out: no field of the generator's data is numeric without a parser, so every build answers an empty result. Run with the control set.

nested-aggregation.description: A vector aggregation over another one keeps every level's own `by` (semantics/nested-aggregation-outer-by-native-routes, with the `without` levels of semantics/without-over-inner-aggregation-collapses and semantics/without-nested-under-aggregation): the translator sent the nest to VictoriaLogs as one outer aggregation and dropped the outer grouping, so an instant query and a tumbling window (range == step, `[$__auto]`) answered one series without labels where Loki answers one per group. N1-N8 are range queries over tumbling windows (two-level nests of sum, max, min, avg and count, a three-level chain, a `| json` and a `| logfmt` inner level, a `without` over a level that names its labels), N9-N13 the same forms as instant queries, N13 with an innermost `without`, N14-N15 sliding windows (range 5m over the step), which the proxy folds from the innermost level's series (a nest of sums goes through the same fold). N16 is the innermost `without` on a tumbling window, which VictoriaLogs folds itself when the excluded labels are plain names (the proxy folds the series rows otherwise: a parser, an underscore or derived label, a sliding window). The selector leaves out the OTel-instrumented streams and the otel-collector: Loki carries their structured metadata (trace_id, span_id) in the series, so an inner level grouped by pod counts per line there, a series identity difference that predates the nest fix and is not what this set measures. Run with the control set.

shapes.name: N1 sum by app of max by app,pod, count
shapes.query: sum by (app) (max by (app, pod) (count_over_time({env="production", instrumentation!="otel", app!="otel-collector"}[$__auto])))
